meta.name: Canonical Grant Question Bank
meta.description: Normalized, deduplicated grant application questions synthesized from real, publicly published funder forms. Each canonical question aggregates the real-world variants that map to it, so an incoming funder question can be matched to one canonical entry and routed to the Knowledge Base answer that satisfies it. v0.2 extends the bank with the Philadelphia/regional, corporate, federal, and PA-state forms captured in sources/philadelphia-regional-and-sector-forms.md, adding eligibility-gate, innovation, risk, capacity, and federal/state structured-field questions. v0.3 adds the two Aug-7 pilot forms (GSK STEM Access, Truist Foundation Inspire Awards) as variants; see sources/aug7-pilot-forms.md.

meta.notes: kb_ref points to a LaunchPad Knowledge Base entry (see research/Wireframes.md). Entries prefixed kb.profile.* are structured org-profile fields, not narrative answers. limits are the real caps observed in sources; the pipeline resizes canonical answers to whichever limit an incoming form imposes. The 'eligibility' category holds hard pass/fail funder-fit gates (kb.eligibility) intended to feed the prospecting/fit-scoring path (C1), not just form-filling.
